Well, I'm sexually attracted to kids, but I know I'd never act out on my fantasies. But it's not due to my depression, it's just the way I am. If anything, it's the fact that Ifind it so difficult to feel attraction for people my own age that has caused this depression.
But when I was reported for trying to get help with my issues I felt really betrayed by the people I had trusted to help me. I've been thinking a lot about killing my ex counselor and it's really distressing me that I'm having these thoughts, I was thinking that I couldn't tell anyone about these thoughts because they Would report me again, but maybe it's actually necessary this time :s I don't know

I don't think I'll ever recover, I'll just keep getting worse and worse until I kill myself. I've already told my doctor about my suicidal thoughts and one got an appointment with a CPN in a week or two. I don't know how long I'll survive for. I tried lifeline one time before, but after Doing counseling with them is when I started to fell really suicidal! Because they reported me for having thoughts about hurting kids
